title: Eight Decades of Educational Assortative Mating (CDE Working Paper No. 2022-01; published as "Eight Decades of Educational Assortative Mating: A Research Note," Demography 61(5):1293-1307, 2024)
author: Noah Hirschl, Christine R. Schwartz, Elia Boschetti
publication: Center for Demography and Ecology, University of Wisconsin-Madison, CDE Working Paper No. 2022-01 (draft dated 2023-02-24); published version in Demography, DOI 10.1215/00703370-11558914
accessedVia: curl fetch of https://r.jina.ai/<PDF URL> (Jina AI Reader text-extraction proxy) rendered the working-paper PDF as clean markdown/text, read directly via the Read tool. Direct PDF binary fetch via WebFetch, and the Duke University Press HTML article page (https://read.dukeupress.edu/demography/article/61/5/1293/390842/), both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. The CDE working-paper landing page (https://cde.wisc.edu/wp-2022-01/) independently reproduced the same abstract text, corroborating the working-paper PDF's abstract verbatim.
notes: isOpenAccess refers to the working-paper version at cde.wisc.edu, which is freely hosted and was the version actually read primary. The final Demography-published version (Duke University Press) is NOT confirmed open access -- it returned 403 without evident subscription/institutional access; its abstract was corroborated secondhand via search-engine renderings of the Duke UP page and via a secondary blog (schoolinfosystem.org) that quotes it, and that abstract text is identical, word for word, to the working-paper abstract captured in raw-01.txt. No full-text diff of working paper vs. published version was possible (published body text unreachable). Two additional primary sources were also fetched in full via the same r.jina.ai proxy technique to support relationship analysis in evidence-notes.md (their extracts are NOT included in raw-01.txt per the one-artifact cap): (a) Esteve, Albert, Christine R. Schwartz, Jan Van Bavel, Inaki Permanyer, Martin Klesment, and Joan Garcia-Roman. 'The End of Hypergamy: Global Trends and Implications.' Population and Development Review 42(4):615-625 (2016). Retrieved from https://ced.cat/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Population_Development_Review_2016_A.Esteve_et-al.pdf via r.jina.ai proxy -- full text read, 120 countries, 1960-2011, IPUMS-International + DHS + other survey/census microdata, N > 0.5 billion person-records. (b) Schwartz, Christine R. and Robert D. Mare. 'Trends in Educational Assortative Marriage From 1940 to 2003.' Demography 42:621-646 (2005). DOI 10.1353/dem.2005.0036. This one was NOT reached in full text -- Springer/Project MUSE page (https://link.springer.com/article/10.1353/dem.2005.0036), fetched via the same r.jina.ai technique, returned only its reference list (paywalled body); its abstract was read only secondhand via a PubMed page rendering (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16463914/), processed through WebFetch's summarizing model rather than read as raw extracted text -- flagged as a GAP in evidence-notes.md.
